prompt: Who is the only female artist to have topped Spotify's list of most-streamed artists in three consecutive years (2020–2022)?
answer: No female artist did so in 2020–2022. **Bad Bunny** was Spotify’s most-streamed global artist in each of those three years. **Taylor Swift** is the only female artist to top the annual list, doing so in **2023 and 2024**.
